findings.subject: entity-iga-complexes
findings.text: Uncomplexed IgA1 did not significantly alter proliferation in the reported mesangial-cell culture assay, limiting attribution of the complex effect to IgA1 alone.
findings.quote: uncomplexed IgA1 did not affect MC proliferation significantly
findings.studySystem: Serum fractions from IgAN patients added to cultured mesangial cells
limitations: This culture comparison does not establish the effects of uncomplexed IgA1 in vivo or in every mesangial context.
findings.distinctFindingRationale: The uncomplexed-IgA1 control is a separate finding from the large-complex stimulation and smaller-complex inhibition already entered from this study.
